issues.message: Bound features should have conforming types

startup.scope: First model step with all inputs at their contract initial values; not a hardware or full behavior proof.

pause.scope: Press-edge pause output invariant on synthetic public stimuli; not complete period/resume verification.

periodic.scope: Bounded public pulse, phase and pause/resume traces; no hardware or unbounded proof.

numeric.scope: Public short-edge counter and sampled mapping/parity assertions only; no full hold timing or hardware proof.

coverage.scope: Interface, state/dependency coverage and requested public behavior assertions only. Full behavior requires independent tests.
